1245194.question_the_register_could_not_answer: Blank narration on all five in-scope lines; Nature Detail read '(blank narration)' and one line sat at Pending evidence, Tier 3.
1245194.answer: The document is the reversal of the June 2026 Plant & Fleet Services accrual. It debits the two PFS revenue accrual accounts, 1-13081-6D513 $21,057.77 and 1-13121-6D513 $13,656.71, both narrated 'Reversing Journal-June Accruals-for PFS Revenue', and credits the accrued plant, workshop and recharge expense back across 29 Council ledger legs on 7C111, 7C112 and 7C114. Five of those legs sit on branch O110-O115 and are the five register lines.

cols.25: Reversal of the June 2026 Plant & Fleet Services accrual, credited back to this PK on the internal plant and fleet accounts. Source document 1245194 (GJ080153) debits the PFS revenue accruals 1-13081-6D513 $21,057.77 and 1-13121-6D513 $13,656.71, narrated 'Reversing Journal-June Accruals-for PFS Revenue', and credits 29 Council expense legs on 7C111, 7C112 and 7C114 totalling $34,714.48, of which the five branch legs total $3,289.09.

cols.32: Accrual reversal read as a set under rules 5 and 6, so the line is a T9 event and is excluded from operational spend and trend. The June 2026 accrual it reverses was raised in FY2025/26 and is outside this pull (Open Item B-011).

1248219.question_the_register_could_not_answer: The set does not net to zero inside O110-O115 (+$51,121.41), so the balancing leg was outside scope and unknown (Open Item B-012).
1248219.answer: The balancing legs are a G ledger clearing entry, 1330-1-31123 $43,784.58 narrated 'Reverse PJ009910-Reversal', and three cost centre E0035 credits: 1-E0035-73609 $6,880.00 (Digital Platforms), 1-E0035-73513 $258.06 and 1-E0035-72111 $198.77 (Credit card). None sits inside O110-O115 and none is a Plant & Fleet revenue account, so nothing in the document supports the plant hire charge that the three debits carry.
1248219.finding: The three debits reproduce to the cent three of the six plant hire legs that GJ080188 (document 1246521) posted on 01-Jul-2025 to 30-Jun-2026 and that IJ075016 (document 1247889) reversed in full: $27,374.51 (plant F007834, PK000435, Park Services), $23,717.08 (plant F006632, PK000396, Park Maintenance) and $29.82 (plant F008368, PK000068, Natural Areas). GJ080309 posts all three to PK000068. On the evidence of the original legs, $51,091.59 of the $51,121.41 sits on the wrong PK: $27,374.51 belongs to PK000435 and $23,717.08 to PK000396. The GJ080309 legs carry no plant reference in narration line 3, where every GJ080188 leg carries one. The remaining three original legs, PK000012 $1,733.20, PK000034 $227.10 and PK000083 $12.18 ($1,972.48), were reversed and never re-posted.

cols.25: Recode journal posting plant hire billing for 01-Jul-2025 to 30-Jun-2026 to PK000068 on 7C111. Source document 1248219 (GJ080309) debits PK000068 three times, $27,374.51, $23,717.08 and $29.82, all narrated 'Plant Hire Billing-Reversal', and credits G ledger 1330-1-31123 $43,784.58 ('Reverse PJ009910-Reversal'), SL 1-E0035-73609 $6,880.00 (Digital Platforms), SL 1-E0035-73513 $258.06 and SL 1-E0035-72111 $198.77 (Credit card).

cols.32: Open Item B-012 answered for this document: the balancing legs sit on G ledger 1330-1-31123 and cost centre E0035, outside O110-O115, and none is a Plant & Fleet revenue account. The three debits reproduce to the cent three of the six plant hire legs GJ080188 posted and IJ075016 reversed, but all three land on PK000068 where GJ080188 assigned $27,374.51 to PK000435 and $23,717.08 to PK000396 against plant F007834 and F006632; only the $29.82 leg (plant F008368) was PK000068's. On that evidence $51,091.59 sits on the wrong PK and Natural Areas is overstated by that amount (Open Item B-030).
cols.34: Ask Finance to confirm the PK split on GJ080309 against the plant references on GJ080188 (F007834 PK000435, F006632 PK000396, F008368 PK000068) and to recode $27,374.51 to PK000435 and $23,717.08 to PK000396 if confirmed; also confirm why the PK000012, PK000034 and PK000083 legs totalling $1,972.48 were reversed by IJ075016 and never re-posted (Open Item B-030).

1252466.question_the_register_could_not_answer: Both lines carried the generic coding note 'Invoice may bundle multiple items and services; nature unproven at line level'.
1252466.answer: Document 2 of file 1252466 is the internal rates journal for rating period 2027-1, schedule S03. It raises $34,505.71 against City Bank 1330-1-11111 and allocates it over 53 Council property legs (fire levy, internal water, sewerage, garbage and trade waste). Two legs land on Parks PK000092 at $8.65 each: the Parks share of the $17.65 fire levy on assessment 9915980, 41-43 Alvine Drive, and assessment 9916059, 38 Wyndham Circuit, the other $9.00 of each levy going to SL 1-30071-73422.
